minutes.headline: Finance Committee appointed a member to the town's Paseos building design committee; no budget votes were taken.
minutes.summary: The committee heard public comment questioning its school liaison's remarks on student fees, and the liaison responded. It discussed the planned building design committee, a possible service level committee, and how to set goals and agendas before budget season. It appointed a member to the building design committee and approved the August 8 minutes.

public_comment.topic: A resident of Barton Reservoir Road criticized the Finance Committee liaison to the School Committee for speaking about student user fees, saying it blurred roles and could look like personal financial gain.
A planning board chair (Matt Allison as heard) said economic development, a master planning subcommittee and the master plan would benefit from input from this committee and business.

votes.motion: Appoint Dave to the building design committee for the Paseos

budget_items.what_was_said: A planning board speaker said an appropriation came through capital planning and a matching grant is being sought. It will probably not cover the whole consultant cost.
A member relayed from the Board of Selectmen that free cash appears to be about a million dollars, not certified.
A resident said the liaison projected the family's year-end school cost.

decisions.decision: Chair will ask the school superintendent about auditorium availability on Thursdays in October for the joint meeting, and members will send available dates within a week.
Chair to ask the town manager to give the budget process presentation on September 12; goals discussion to follow; a member to prepare the next agenda.

The chair will ask the school superintendent about auditorium dates for a joint meeting, and members will send available dates within a week.

why_it_matters: The building design committee shapes the Paseos project, so who sits on it affects the plans and costs that may later come to residents as a funding vote.
Free cash is not yet certified, so the estimate heard here could change how much is available to offset taxes or fund requests at Town Meeting.
The goals and budget process sessions set the order in which the committee reviews budgets, which affects when residents can comment before spending is decided.
